concept: Functions package reusable logic. Lists hold ordered items; dictionaries map keys to values. Choose structures that match the problem.
breakdown: orders is a list of dictionaries, each representing one order.
The function accepts rows as an argument and creates a fresh totals dictionary.

return makes the result available to the caller; print only displays it.
practice: Write a function count_by_customer(rows) that returns the number of orders for each customer.
takeaways: Prefer returning data over printing inside reusable functions.
